name: Mahjong for a Cause
description: Community mahjong at Hall's Hall in Friendswood with lessons, open play and leagues; proceeds support local causes. Official page quote: "Complete all 72 hands on the 2026 NMJL Card" (A League of Your Own series). Event pages say all levels welcome. Open play $10-$15 per session; Mahjong 101 $40.
schedule: Open play Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat; Mahjong 101 on Wednesdays (see site for dates)
